Archive / Subjects / Controlled vocabulary
Discovery / Term authority register

Words with a record.

46 subject access terms and 4 resource genres, with local definitions, relationships, and accountable editorial provenance.

How to use this register

A maintained local vocabulary for consistent access to this selected Museum of One corpus. Definitions describe how terms are used here; they do not replace source wording or claim external authority endorsement.

Preferred terms support consistent discovery. Alternative labels lead to the same concept. Broader and narrower terms express local hierarchy; related terms connect distinct ideas. Named subjects are access points and link to separate entity authority records where available.

Original Zenodo keywords remain in each item’s source metadata. These controlled terms describe the archive’s editorial access layer. An external reference is never an assertion that the entire local vocabulary has been approved by that institution.

Download SKOS JSON-LD · Download the full term register · Search the catalogue

Vocabulary edition 4 · Reviewed 2026-11-04
Editorial owner: Museum of One Digital Archive Library. New labels require a documented scope, source warrant, and review before assignment. Stable local identifiers are retained when labels change. External mappings require a checked authority record and an explicit relationship.
